root_cause.text: `xfrm6_rcv_encap()` fails to release the reference to the `dst_entry` returned by `ip6_route_input_lookup()` when the route lookup resolves to an error route, resulting in a memory leak when the packet is dropped.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that inside `xfrm6_rcv_encap()`, when `dst->error` is true, `dst_release(dst)` is added to release the reference before jumping to the `drop` label.
